🤖 Talos triage · confidence: medium

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
Treating this as a real break rather than user error — the report ran until two days ago and now errors every time — but the failure message our platform already recorded for those runs has not been read yet, so nothing about what broke is established.

What we checked

  • The reprint-related fields this report is built on are still present and correctly declared in this customer's field configuration — nothing has been removed from it.

  • This customer's reporting runs against the newer data platform on a fixed capacity setting, and the newer feature that automatically resizes that capacity per report is not switched on for them — so an automatic-resizing/slowness explanation is ruled out.

  • The report itself is not in the checked-in configuration we hold; it is a saved report stored in the customer's environment, so its definition can only be read there.

Next

  • Pull the recorded failure message (and the query it generated) for this report's failed runs over the last two days — no reproduction needed, and it names the failure directly.

  • Check whether this report's definition, or the shared field configuration it depends on, was edited or redeployed in the last few days.

Prepared: 02 October 2026 | Analyst: Enrique Jimenez | Status: WORK IN PROGRESS

1. Ticket Details

Field

Value

Ticket

Customer

Urban Outfitters (Urban Terrain / c044_urb)

Issue Type

Incident

Work in Progress

Timothy Berry (tberry1@urbn.com)

Assignee

Enrique Jimenez (ejimenez@apprissretail.com)

Jira URL

https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-29231

2. Problem Statement

For the last 2 days, any attempt to run the "Cashier Summary - Refund where Original Transaction was Reprint Receipt" report, or any derivative of it, returns an error. The report is described as crucial to investigative efforts; field users are affected.

3. Client Profile

Field

Value

Client ID

c044_urb

Region

US

ARDM version

V2 (snowtimeV2)

Snowflake schema

ARDM_PRODUCTION.C044_URB (output) / C044_URB_SNOWTIME (working)

Active products

SnowTime dbt pipeline + Secure Search/Composer reporting

4. Investigation

4.1 Error reproduction / log correlation

Query: Reviewed Application Insights logs against the user-supplied failing SQL (Snowflake query generated by the Secure report composer for this report).

PASS (reproduced). The exact backend error was logged twice on 2026-10-01 (~22:08 and ~22:11): Numeric value '' is not recognized SqlState: 22018, VendorCode: 100038. This confirms the generic UI message ("Sorry but we couldn't process your search") maps directly to this Snowflake-side error.

4.2 Query structure analysis

Query: Reviewed the generated SQL. The report compares the x_rcpt_count extension column (on ardm_header) with > against a numeric parameter ($RefSearch..._x_rcpt_count = 0), inside two nested sub-searches used as a Data Area ("Receipt Reprint Transaction List").

POINT OF FAILURE FOUND. The comparison forces Snowflake to implicitly cast x_rcpt_count to NUMBER row by row. Any row where the column holds an empty string or non-numeric text breaks the entire query — a single bad row aborts the whole result set.

4.3 Column type / history check (dbt/SnowTime side)

Query: Reviewed map_ardm_header.sql (c044_urb) and its PR history.

FINDING. x_rcpt_count was changed from INT to VARCHAR in RCS-29028 (PR 58068, merged 2026-09-23) — a correct fix, because the underlying POS field RPRT_RCPT_COUNT is alphanumeric (e.g. TP58629668), not a true numeric count. Before that fix, the INT cast silently NULLed almost every value, which is why no numeric comparison had ever broken before.

4.4 Data volume validation

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       COUNT_IF(X_RCPT_COUNT IS NULL) AS null_count,
       COUNT_IF(X_RCPT_COUNT = '') AS empty_string_count,
       COUNT_IF(X_RCPT_COUNT IS NOT NULL AND X_RCPT_COUNT != '' AND TRY_CAST(X_RCPT_COUNT AS NUMBER) IS NULL) AS non_numeric_nonempty_count
FROM ARDM_PRODUCTION.C044_URB.ARDM_HEADER
WHERE TRADINGDAY BETWEEN '2025-09-03' AND '2026-10-02'

PASS (confirms root cause). 100,520,704 total rows — 1,292,220 with x_rcpt_count = '' and 94,787 with non-numeric alphanumeric values. Any of these rows breaks a numeric cast/comparison on this column.

4.5 Schema consistency check

SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH
FROM ARDM_PRODUCTION.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA IN ('C044_URB', 'C044_URB_SNOWTIME') AND COLUMN_NAME = 'X_RCPT_COUNT'

PASS. TEXT type is consistent across MAP_ARDM_HEADER, ENRICH_ARDM_HEADER, BASE_FF_ARDM_HEADER, ARDM_HEADER, and QUARANTINE_ARDM_HEADER — no schema drift today. The dbt/SnowTime pipeline is correctly and consistently typed; the mismatch is isolated to the Secure report's field configuration.

4.6 Related-incident precedent

Query: Reviewed RTS-208663 ("[SnowTime] C044_URB [GP3 | US LA4] — dbt pipeline failure", Closed).

FINDING. The identical error occurred one day earlier (2026-09-30) on a QUARANTINE_ARDM_HEADER DML operation. It was resolved only operationally (task resumed), with no root cause documented — same underlying cause, never fixed at the source.

5. Root Cause Statement

Field

Detail

What broke

The "Cashier Summary - Refund where Original Transaction was Reprint Receipt" report and its "Receipt Reprint Transaction List" data-area sub-search, both of which filter x_rcpt_count with a numeric comparison (> 0)

Why

x_rcpt_count (an ardm_header extension column for client c044_urb) was correctly changed from INT to VARCHAR in RCS-29028 (2026-09-23) because the underlying POS field is alphanumeric. The Secure report's field configuration was never updated to match — it still treats the field as numeric, so Snowflake throws Numeric value '' is not recognized on any row with an empty-string or non-numeric value

Scope

All of C044_URB.ARDM_HEADER (~100.5M rows): 1,292,220 rows with an empty string, 94,787 with non-numeric alphanumeric values. Any report/search applying a numeric comparison to this column is equally exposed, not just this one report

Business impact

Client describes the report as crucial to investigative efforts; field users unable to run it or any derivative — High priority, ~2 days of outage at time of report

Evidence

See §4.4 / §4.5 queries above; RTS-208663 precedent (§4.6)

6. Additional Findings

  • RTS-208663 shows this is a recurring symptom, not a one-off — the underlying field-config mismatch was never corrected after its first occurrence (2026-09-30).

  • Other reports/searches for c044_urb that compare x_rcpt_count numerically are presumably equally exposed and should be audited proactively.

7. Recommended Fix

Option A — Fix the Secure field config (Recommended)

Update the field configuration for x_rcpt_count on the affected c044_urb report/search definitions from Numeric to Text, and replace the numeric filter (> 0) with a text-based check (IS NOT NULL AND != ''). This is a Secure-side configuration change — the VARCHAR type in dbt/SnowTime is correct and documented (RCS-29028); no dbt change is needed or recommended.

Implementation steps:

  1. Identify every report/search using x_rcpt_count with a numeric operator — start with "Cashier Summary - Refund where Original Transaction was Reprint Receipt" and "Receipt Reprint Transaction List".

  2. Recategorize the field type to Text in each report/search's field/parameter config.

  3. Replace > 0 filters with IS NOT NULL AND != ''.

  4. Re-test the report against c044_urb production.

  5. Audit other c044_urb reports for the same pattern to prevent recurrence (ties to the RTS-208663 precedent).

8. Open Questions

  • Confirm with Enrique Jimenez whether other c044_urb reports share the same numeric-comparison pattern on x_rcpt_count.

  • Confirm whether the sibling field x_rcpt_id_em (same source/history) needs the same audit — current usage is string-based (ILIKE) and not at risk today, but worth a proactive check.

  • No further dbt/SnowTime action is needed — the SnowTime-side investigation is closed; remaining work is the Secure field-config fix (owned by the assignee).

set RefSearch1_ticketamount = 0;
set RefSearch3_SubSearchParam_2_x_rcpt_count = 0;
set RefSearch3_SubSearchParam_2_voidticketflg = false;
set RefSearch4_x_rcpt_count = 0;
set RefSearch4_voidticketflg = false;

WITH T9AsCte AS (
SELECT
T10.TransactionID AS transactionid,
T10.StoreNo AS storeno,
T10.CashierNo AS cashierno,
T10.BusinessDate AS businessdate,
T10.EndTransDateTime AS endtransdatetime,
T10.POSNo AS posno,
T10.TicketNo AS ticketno,
T10.TicketAmount AS ticketamount,
T10.x_rcpt_count AS x_rcpt_count,
T10.x_rcpt_id_em AS x_rcpt_id_em
FROM ardm_Header AS T10
WHERE
(
(T10.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-03T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-10-02T23:59:59' AS DATE))
AND
(T10.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-03T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-10-02T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND
(T10.x_rcpt_count > $RefSearch3_SubSearchParam_2_x_rcpt_count AND T10.StdTransactionType = 1 AND T10.VoidTicketFlg = $RefSearch3_SubSearchParam_2_voidticketflg)
), T5AsCte AS (
SELECT
T11.TransactionID AS transactionid,
T11.EndTransDateTime AS endtransdatetime,
T11.x_rcpt_id_em AS x_rcpt_id_em,
T11.x_rcpt_count AS x_rcpt_count
FROM ardm_Header AS T11
WHERE
(
(T11.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-03T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-10-02T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND
(T11.x_rcpt_count > $RefSearch4_x_rcpt_count AND T11.StdTransactionType = 1 AND T11.VoidTicketFlg = $RefSearch4_voidticketflg)
), T1AsCte AS (
SELECT
T2.StoreNo AS storeno,
T2.CashierNo AS cashierno,
T6.Value AS transactiontype,
T2.EndTransDateTime AS endtransdatetime,
T2.POSNo AS posno,
T2.TicketNo AS ticketno,
T2.TicketAmount AS ticketamount,
T7.Value AS tender_tendertype,
T3.AccountNumber AS tender_accountnumber,
T3.Amount AS tender_amount,
T4.OrigTransactionID AS recalledtransaction_origtransactionid,
T5.x_rcpt_count AS "Receipt Reprint Transaction List_x_rcpt_count",
T5.x_rcpt_id_em AS "Receipt Reprint Transaction List_x_rcpt_id_em",
T4.OrigStoreNo AS recalledtransaction_origstoreno,
T4.OrigCashierNo AS recalledtransaction_origcashierno,
T4.OrigEndTransDateTime AS recalledtransaction_origEndTransDateTime,
T4.OrigPOSNo AS recalledtransaction_origposno,
T4.OrigTicketNo AS recalledtransaction_origticketno,
T4.OrigTicketAmount AS recalledtransaction_origticketamount,
T8.Value AS recalledtransaction_origprimarytendertype,
T4.OrigPrimaryTenderToken AS recalledtransaction_origprimarytendertoken,
T2.TransactionID AS transactionid
FROM ardm_Header AS T2
LEFT JOIN ardm_Tender AS T3
ON (T2.TransactionID = T3.TransactionID AND T2.TradingDay = T3.TradingDay)
LEFT JOIN ardm_RecalledTransaction AS T4
ON (T2.TransactionID = T4.TransactionID AND T2.TradingDay = T4.TradingDay)
LEFT JOIN secure_EnumerationReferenceData AS T6
ON (T6.EnumerationType = 'headertransactiontype' AND T6.Culture = 'en-GB' AND T6.KeyAsInt = T2.TransactionType)
LEFT JOIN secure_EnumerationReferenceData AS T7
ON (T7.EnumerationType = 'tendertype' AND T7.Culture = 'en-GB' AND T7.KeyAsInt = T3.TenderType)
LEFT JOIN secure_EnumerationReferenceData AS T8
ON (T8.EnumerationType = 'tendertype' AND T8.Culture = 'en-GB' AND T8.KeyAsInt = T4.OrigPrimaryTenderType)
LEFT JOIN T9AsCte AS T9
ON (T4.OrigTransactionID = T9.transactionid)
INNER JOIN T5AsCte AS T5
ON (T4.OrigTransactionID = T5.transactionid AND T2.EndTransDateTime > T5.endtransdatetime AND T2.CashierNo ILIKE '%' || T5.x_rcpt_id_em || '%')
WHERE
(
(T2.TradingDay BETWEEN CAST('2025-09-03T00:00:00' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-10-02T23:59:59' AS DATE))
)
AND

@David Parraga could you route this to the SnowTime / Data team (Sebastian Rueda worked the related RCS-29028), please? It's a data mapping regression from SnowTime PR 58068, not a Secure configuration issue.

What's breaking: the report filters x_rcpt_count > 0 (transactions with a reprinted receipt) and matches the refund cashier against x_rcpt_id_em (CashierNo ILIKE '%' || x_rcpt_id_em || '%', sub-search "cashier contains reprint employee id"). Since PR 58068, x_rcpt_count is VARCHAR with empty and alphanumeric values, so Snowflake fails with Numeric value '' is not recognized (tracking codes c84ad838-5c45-5d3a-8e32-26164df006f7, 12fc932f-bbdd-5384-a510-979d3cf6ee8d).

Root cause: PR 58068 (RCS-29028, merged 2026-09-23) shifted both reprint fields to the wrong columns.

  • The URBN header file grew from 38 to 40 columns around 2026-08-24. The PR assumed the 2 new columns were inserted before RPRT_RCPT_ID_EM / RPRT_RCPT_COUNT (labelled SECONDARY_EMP_NO / SECONDARY_EMP_FLAG, "pending URBN confirmation"), and moved both reprint fields 2 positions later.

  • The legacy data shows that assumption is wrong. In ARDMPROD.ARDM_044.ARDM_HEADER, 2026-07-01 to 08-20 (before the layout change):

    • x_rcpt_count is a clean reprint count: 0 = 4,958,441 rows, 1 = 66,115, 2 = 4,114, 3 = 629, max 17.

    • On rows with x_rcpt_count > 0, x_rcpt_id_em is the reprinting employee's id, and it matches the tail of cashierno (e.g. 0345671 / 022110000345671, 381055 / 004850000381055).

  • The PR's own documentation for the "new" SECONDARY_EMP_NO gives the sample value 381055: one of those reprint employee ids. It describes SECONDARY_EMP_FLAG as "0/1, flips to 1 in step with SECONDARY_EMP_NO being populated", which is exactly reprint count + reprint employee. So positions 35/36 are still RPRT_RCPT_ID_EM / RPRT_RCPT_COUNT. The genuinely new fields are the ones after them: the ecom order number (C014480111043) and the TP… reference.

  • This also fits the timeline. From 08-24 until PR 58068 deployed, SnowTime still read positions 35/36 and the report kept working. It broke after the deploy (and RTS-208663 hit the same error on 09-30).

Requested fix (SnowTime, client c044_urb):

  1. Map positions 35/36 back to x_rcpt_id_em / x_rcpt_count, with x_rcpt_count as INT.

  2. Keep the ecom order number that RCS-29028 needs for the Direct Return linkage in its own column, without overwriting x_rcpt_id_em.

  3. Ideally confirm the 40-column layout with URBN.

  4. Backfill from the PR 58068 deploy date.

Why not change it on the Secure side: switching the field to text and filtering on != '' would stop the error, but the report would match unrelated codes instead of reprints, and the employee join would never match. The arpfiles definition for client 44 (x_rcpt_count Int16, "Reprint Count") is correct and should stay as it is.
